villager.Abigail.Aftermath.01: The graveyard's quiet again. Not boring quiet. The good kind.$h
villager.Abigail.Aftermath.02: I sharpened my sword for nothing this week. For once, I'm glad.$h
villager.Abigail.Cultists.01: I saw three shapes between the trees. When I blinked, one of them was closer.$s
villager.Abigail.Cultists.02: Dad says it's just shadows. Since when do shadows watch you walk home?
villager.Abigail.Severed.01: I went back to the old path. Nothing followed me home this time.$h
villager.Abigail.Severed.02: Strange. The woods still feel old, but they don't feel hungry anymore.$h
villager.Abigail.Temple.01: There's a place beyond the forest that feels wrong, even from here. Tell me I'm imagining it.$u
villager.Abigail.Temple.02: Whatever's been waking up out there, it isn't interested in buried treasure.$u
villager.Abigail.Unease.01: I went toward the old path with my sword. Something made me turn around before I even reached it.$u
villager.Abigail.Unease.02: There's a kind of humming under the ground lately. I wish I knew what it was.$u
villager.Abigail.Whispers.01: The graveyard felt different last night. Like someone had been standing just behind me.$u
villager.Abigail.Whispers.02: I heard a bell from the woods. There isn't a bell out there, is there?
villager.Alex.Aftermath.01: Finally got a good night's sleep. I didn't realize how long it had been.$h
villager.Alex.Aftermath.02: I ran past the woods today. Felt like a normal morning again.$h
villager.Alex.Cultists.01: Grandma says not to go near the forest after dark. I think I'll listen this time.$u
villager.Alex.Cultists.02: Something was standing near the road last night. I couldn't make out a face.$s
villager.Alex.Severed.01: There's something nice about ordinary mornings. Don't tell anyone I said that.$h
villager.Alex.Severed.02: Been running farther lately. It's good not having that feeling at my back.$h
villager.Alex.Temple.01: Even the field feels strange. I keep expecting the ground to move.$u
villager.Alex.Temple.02: I'd rather face a whole team than whatever's making those noises at night.
villager.Alex.Unease.01: You ever feel watched during training? Probably just my imagination, right?
villager.Alex.Unease.02: Dust came off the ground when I was lifting. No wind, no truck. Weird.
villager.Alex.Whispers.01: I was out running before sunrise. Heard something moving beside the road, keeping pace with me.$u
villager.Alex.Whispers.02: My morning run felt weird today. Like somebody was counting my steps.
villager.Caroline.Aftermath.01: My tea garden feels peaceful again. I'd nearly forgotten that feeling.$h
villager.Caroline.Aftermath.02: Abigail came home laughing last night. It was wonderful to hear.$h
villager.Caroline.Cultists.01: Pierre thinks the figures people mention are tourists. Tourists don't vanish into trees.$u
villager.Caroline.Cultists.02: I asked Abigail to be home before sunset. She actually agreed. That worries me.$s
villager.Caroline.Severed.01: The leaves are turning toward the sunlight again, as they should.$h
villager.Caroline.Severed.02: Come by for tea sometime. I'd like to talk about something pleasantly ordinary.$h
villager.Caroline.Temple.01: The garden's been growing unevenly, even with the same light and water.$u
villager.Caroline.Temple.02: I spent an hour tending a plant that wasn't sick. I suppose I just needed something to do.
villager.Caroline.Unease.01: I've been leaving the curtains open. I don't like what I imagine when they're closed.$u
villager.Caroline.Unease.02: Abigail's been asking about unusual sounds. I wish I had an answer for her.
villager.Caroline.Whispers.01: The tea leaves have been making the strangest shapes. Probably nothing.$u
villager.Caroline.Whispers.02: My sunroom plants keep turning toward the same empty corner.
villager.Clint.Aftermath.01: The forge has been steady all week. That's a relief I didn't expect.$h
villager.Clint.Aftermath.02: It's nice when a hammer sounds like a hammer again.$h
villager.Clint.Cultists.01: A hooded person stood outside after closing. When I went to ask what they wanted, nobody was there.$s
villager.Clint.Cultists.02: I'm keeping the shutters closed at night. It helps me concentrate. Sort of.
villager.Clint.Severed.01: No strange vibrations, no cold furnace. Just honest work.$h
villager.Clint.Severed.02: I've stopped checking the shop door every few minutes. Mostly.$h
villager.Clint.Temple.01: Whatever's under the ground is making the old iron behave strangely.$u
villager.Clint.Temple.02: I found marks on a scrap of metal that I definitely didn't make.
villager.Clint.Unease.01: Some of the old metal in my shop has started humming at night. I didn't know metal could do that.$u
villager.Clint.Unease.02: The furnace went cold for a second with a full load of coal. Never seen that.
villager.Clint.Whispers.01: Had a tool ring on its hook all by itself. Must've been the vibration from the forge.$u
villager.Clint.Whispers.02: My hammer sounds different against the anvil lately. Can't explain it.
villager.Demetrius.Aftermath.01: The readings have returned to baseline. I'll continue monitoring them.$h
villager.Demetrius.Aftermath.02: This is the first stable data set I've recorded in weeks.$h
villager.Demetrius.Cultists.01: Those reports of figures in the forest don't match any wildlife activity I know of.$u
villager.Demetrius.Cultists.02: I collected an unusual reading just before dawn. Every sensor registered it.$u
villager.Demetrius.Severed.01: For once, my instruments and the weather report agree.$h
villager.Demetrius.Severed.02: The valley's returning to its normal patterns. That's excellent news.$h
villager.Demetrius.Temple.01: The disturbances are converging on a single region, but the source remains unknown.$u
villager.Demetrius.Temple.02: I could publish these results, if anyone would believe the underlying measurements.
villager.Demetrius.Unease.01: I've repeated the same measurement six times. The anomaly is consistent, which makes it more troubling.$u
villager.Demetrius.Unease.02: Something is interfering with my sensors near the southern woods.
villager.Demetrius.Whispers.01: The soil samples show a temperature change I can't account for.$u
villager.Demetrius.Whispers.02: My instruments recorded a pulse with no corresponding weather event. Fascinating.
villager.Elliott.Aftermath.01: The tide is singing its familiar song again. I'm relieved beyond words.$h
villager.Elliott.Aftermath.02: I wrote three pages this morning. Not one was about shadows.$h
villager.Elliott.Cultists.01: I saw a dark silhouette at the end of the pier. It remained after the lanterns went out.$s
villager.Elliott.Cultists.02: I have no metaphor for the shapes I saw among the rocks. That troubles me.
villager.Elliott.Severed.01: I have a new appreciation for stories with happy, uneventful endings.$h
villager.Elliott.Severed.02: The ocean has its secrets, but it seems content to keep them.$h
villager.Elliott.Temple.01: The sea was perfectly still when the earth shuddered. It was profoundly unnatural.$u
villager.Elliott.Temple.02: My story's villain suddenly seems rather ordinary by comparison.
villager.Elliott.Unease.01: A page of my manuscript was covered in handwriting I don't remember writing.$u
villager.Elliott.Unease.02: There's a pause between the waves lately. It makes the shore feel like it's listening.
villager.Elliott.Whispers.01: Last night I dreamed the tide was whispering names I didn't recognize.$u
villager.Elliott.Whispers.02: The ocean usually helps me sleep. Recently, it's had the opposite effect.
villager.Emily.Aftermath.01: I slept all the way through last night. The dreams were bright again.$h
villager.Emily.Aftermath.02: Whatever was weighing on this place feels lighter now.$h
villager.Emily.Cultists.01: I saw someone at the edge of the woods. Their energy felt... empty.$s
villager.Emily.Cultists.02: Even the crystals have been restless. That's never happened to me before.
villager.Emily.Severed.01: The valley's energy is flowing freely again. I hope you can feel it too.$h
villager.Emily.Severed.02: I had a dream about dancing in a field of flowers. Much better.$h
villager.Emily.Temple.01: There's a pressure in the air. It feels like the moment before a thunderstorm, but the sky is clear.$u
villager.Emily.Temple.02: I keep picturing a black doorway when I close my eyes.$s
villager.Emily.Unease.01: My dreams have been unusually heavy lately, like walking underwater.$u
villager.Emily.Unease.02: I tried meditating, but there was another rhythm underneath my breathing.$u
villager.Emily.Whispers.01: I had a dream of a door with no handle. I woke up before it opened.$u
villager.Emily.Whispers.02: Something's changed in the energy around town. I can't quite describe it.
villager.Evelyn.Aftermath.01: The birds were singing when I woke up. Such a simple blessing.$h
villager.Evelyn.Aftermath.02: I baked extra cookies. It's been a while since I felt like celebrating.$h
villager.Evelyn.Cultists.01: Some young people say they've seen strangers after dark. That brings back unpleasant memories.$u
villager.Evelyn.Cultists.02: I told Alex to stay on the main road in the evenings. He promised me he would.
villager.Evelyn.Severed.01: My garden feels like itself again. I think that's worth being grateful for.$h
villager.Evelyn.Severed.02: Whatever troubled this old valley seems to have passed. I hope it stays that way.$h
villager.Evelyn.Temple.01: The roses were closed all morning, even in the sunshine. Most peculiar.$u
villager.Evelyn.Temple.02: I'm not easily frightened, dear. But I've been keeping an extra lamp lit.$u
villager.Evelyn.Unease.01: My grandmother used to tell stories about people who went into the woods and weren't seen again.$u
villager.Evelyn.Unease.02: There are things in the old stories that I've never quite managed to forget.$u
villager.Evelyn.Whispers.01: The birds stopped singing for a moment yesterday. George didn't notice, but I did.$u
villager.Evelyn.Whispers.02: I've lived here a long time. Sometimes the valley reminds me how old it really is.
villager.George.Aftermath.01: Slept fine last night. About time, too.$h
villager.George.Aftermath.02: Good. It's quiet. Now if everyone would stop talking about how quiet it is.
villager.George.Cultists.01: Saw a person standing by the road after dark. Didn't like the look of them.$u
villager.George.Cultists.02: I don't scare easy. Still don't care for what's been happening outside.
villager.George.Severed.01: These are the kinds of days I like. Nothing trying to surprise me.
villager.George.Severed.02: Peace and quiet. You'd think that was too much to ask.
villager.George.Temple.01: The ground shook my chair yesterday. Don't tell me it was a passing cart.
villager.George.Temple.02: I've seen enough strange things in this town for one lifetime.
villager.George.Unease.01: Everyone keeps pretending nothing's wrong. I've got ears, you know.
villager.George.Unease.02: If the woods are making noises, stay out of the woods. Simple enough.
villager.George.Whispers.01: Hmph. Heard footsteps outside and nobody was there. People need better hobbies.
villager.George.Whispers.02: Something rattled the window last night. Wasn't the wind, either.
villager.Gus.Aftermath.01: People have started laughing again. That's the best sound a saloon can have.$h
villager.Gus.Aftermath.02: Business is lively again. I was worried about everyone.$h
villager.Gus.Cultists.01: I've heard more than one story about people in robes near the forest.$u
villager.Gus.Cultists.02: Even the regulars have gone quiet when those strange figures come up in conversation.$u
villager.Gus.Severed.01: Feels good to see the regular crowd enjoying themselves.$h
villager.Gus.Severed.02: First round of coffee's on me today. Just don't tell the others.$h
villager.Gus.Temple.01: There was a sudden silence in the saloon last night. Every glass stopped rattling at once.$u
villager.Gus.Temple.02: I think everyone in town could use a warm meal and a safe place to sit.
villager.Gus.Unease.01: Folks have been staying a little later than usual. I don't think it's just the food.$u
villager.Gus.Unease.02: I've started walking customers to the door after closing. Can't be too careful.
villager.Gus.Whispers.01: A few customers say they've been hearing things on the road home.$u
villager.Gus.Whispers.02: Someone left the saloon early because they thought they saw a light outside the window.
villager.Haley.Aftermath.01: The afternoon light was gorgeous today! Finally.$h
villager.Haley.Aftermath.02: I took so many photos this morning. They're all beautiful.$h
villager.Haley.Cultists.01: Emily said she saw strange people in the forest. I told her to stop walking there alone.$u
villager.Haley.Cultists.02: There's no way I'm going near those trees after sunset. Absolutely not.
villager.Haley.Severed.01: The town looks good in my pictures again. I think I'll make an album.$h
villager.Haley.Severed.02: It's amazing how much better everything looks when you're not worried.$h
villager.Haley.Temple.01: Even the light on the beach looks wrong lately. It's ruining my pictures.$u
villager.Haley.Temple.02: I just want the town to feel normal again. Is that too much to ask?
villager.Haley.Unease.01: I took a picture of the woods and there's something in the background I swear wasn't there.$s
villager.Haley.Unease.02: Some of my photos are making me uncomfortable. I'm putting them away.
villager.Haley.Whispers.01: My photos have these weird dark streaks across them. Maybe the lens needs cleaning.$u
villager.Haley.Whispers.02: It's impossible to get decent outdoor lighting lately. Everything looks so gloomy.
villager.Harvey.Aftermath.01: People are sleeping better. I'm glad to see the improvement.$h
villager.Harvey.Aftermath.02: The clinic's been wonderfully ordinary this week.$h
villager.Harvey.Cultists.01: Several patients have described seeing figures in their peripheral vision.$u
villager.Harvey.Cultists.02: I can't treat something I can't explain. That is not a comfortable position for a doctor.
villager.Harvey.Severed.01: Remember that recovery takes time, even after the cause of stress has passed.$h
villager.Harvey.Severed.02: I'm pleased the town seems to be finding its balance again.$h
villager.Harvey.Temple.01: I've been checking in on the older residents more frequently.$u
villager.Harvey.Temple.02: I wish I could reassure everyone. I'm not certain what I'd be reassuring them about.
villager.Harvey.Unease.01: I'm concerned about the number of patients reporting the same unsettling dreams.$u
villager.Harvey.Unease.02: Stress can affect a whole community, but these symptoms began rather suddenly.
villager.Harvey.Whispers.01: A few people have mentioned unusually restless sleep. It may be seasonal stress.$u
villager.Harvey.Whispers.02: I've been seeing more fatigue than usual lately. Be sure you're getting rest.
villager.Jas.Aftermath.01: The chickens are singing again! Well... clucking.$h
villager.Jas.Aftermath.02: I played outside today and wasn't scared at all.$h
villager.Jas.Cultists.01: I saw some people far away in the trees. Aunt Marnie brought me inside.$s
villager.Jas.Cultists.02: The animals don't like it when it gets dark now.$u
villager.Jas.Severed.01: Aunt Marnie says everything is all right. I believe her.$h
villager.Jas.Severed.02: Vincent and I are making a map of the nicest places in town.$h
villager.Jas.Temple.01: I had a bad dream, but Aunt Marnie made me hot chocolate.$u
villager.Jas.Temple.02: Can you tell the woods to stop being scary?
villager.Jas.Unease.01: I heard someone humming in the woods. Shane said it was probably a bird.$u
villager.Jas.Unease.02: Vincent and I made up a game where the shadows aren't allowed to follow us.
villager.Jas.Whispers.01: The chickens got very quiet last night. Even Charlie.$u
villager.Jas.Whispers.02: Aunt Marnie says not to play by the trees after dinner.
villager.Jodi.Aftermath.01: Vincent slept through the night. That was such a relief.$h
villager.Jodi.Aftermath.02: Our house finally feels restful again.$h
villager.Jodi.Cultists.01: I saw strangers walking toward the forest. I've never seen them shopping in town.$u
villager.Jodi.Cultists.02: Kent's been checking the locks more often. I'm grateful, but I'm worried too.
villager.Jodi.Severed.01: I think I'll make a special dinner tonight. We could all use a nice evening.$h
villager.Jodi.Severed.02: The boys are playing outside again. It's good to hear them laugh.$h
villager.Jodi.Temple.01: I feel as though the whole town is holding its breath.$u
villager.Jodi.Temple.02: I hope whatever's happening stays far away from our homes.
villager.Jodi.Unease.01: I've asked Vincent to be home before dark. He's not pleased about it.$u
villager.Jodi.Unease.02: Some nights I just sit with the lights on, waiting for the house to settle.
villager.Jodi.Whispers.01: The house creaked all night. I hardly slept.$u
villager.Jodi.Whispers.02: Vincent said he heard somebody calling from outside. Nobody was there.
villager.Kent.Aftermath.01: The roads have been quiet lately. I hope it lasts.$h
villager.Kent.Aftermath.02: Jodi seems less worried. That matters more than anything.$h
villager.Kent.Cultists.01: There are people moving through the woods who don't want to be seen.$u
villager.Kent.Cultists.02: I spotted shapes near the pond. Their movements didn't make sense.$u
villager.Kent.Severed.01: I took a walk without checking every corner of the road. Felt good.$h
villager.Kent.Severed.02: It's easier to be present with my family when things are peaceful.$h
villager.Kent.Temple.01: I heard a sound from the hills that set my teeth on edge.$u
villager.Kent.Temple.02: Whatever's out there, I'm keeping my family away from it.
villager.Kent.Unease.01: I don't like unexplained movement near the houses after dark.$u
villager.Kent.Unease.02: I'm keeping a closer eye on the paths around town. Just a precaution.
villager.Kent.Whispers.01: I noticed movement along the tree line before dawn. Couldn't identify it.$u
villager.Kent.Whispers.02: I've started taking the longer route home. Gives me a clearer view of the road.
villager.Krobus.Aftermath.01: The water no longer carries that dreadful echo.$h
villager.Krobus.Aftermath.02: I am not afraid of the shadows again. Only of the things that sometimes hide inside them.
villager.Krobus.Cultists.01: Hooded shapes have passed above the drains. They are not shadow people.$u
villager.Krobus.Cultists.02: My kin avoid the passages near the forest now. I think that is wise.$u
villager.Krobus.Severed.01: The boundary is whole again. I had forgotten how still it could be.$h
villager.Krobus.Severed.02: I hope you are free of what followed you, friend.$h
villager.Krobus.Temple.01: There is a wound between places. I can feel it in the water.$s
villager.Krobus.Temple.02: I have hidden my oldest things. This is not a darkness I wish to greet.$u
villager.Krobus.Unease.01: Something old has stirred deeper than the sewers. It is not one of my people.$u
villager.Krobus.Unease.02: Even the quiet places are keeping their distance from whatever is waking.$u
villager.Krobus.Whispers.01: The darkness beneath the town has acquired an unfamiliar taste.$u
villager.Krobus.Whispers.02: Some shadows have been whispering in a tongue I do not know.$u
villager.Leah.Aftermath.01: I spent all morning painting outdoors. It felt wonderful.$h
villager.Leah.Aftermath.02: The forest finally sounds like a forest again.$h
villager.Leah.Cultists.01: I saw people standing perfectly still among the trees. I packed up my easel.$s
villager.Leah.Cultists.02: The birds go silent just before the strange figures appear.$u
villager.Leah.Severed.01: I think my next sculpture will be something gentle. I've had enough of sharp shapes.$h
villager.Leah.Severed.02: The light through the trees is beautiful today. You should see it.$h
villager.Leah.Temple.01: The soil under my feet felt warm yesterday. The air was freezing.$u
villager.Leah.Temple.02: I brought my work inside. I don't want to stay out there after sunset.$u
villager.Leah.Unease.01: I tried carving today, but the grain looked like a row of watching eyes.$u
villager.Leah.Unease.02: There are places in the forest I don't want to paint anymore.$u
villager.Leah.Whispers.01: I've been sketching the woods, but I keep adding an extra figure without meaning to.$u
villager.Leah.Whispers.02: The forest sounds have changed. I used to know every one of them.
villager.Lewis.Aftermath.01: The complaints have stopped. I hope we can finally put this behind us.$h
villager.Lewis.Aftermath.02: It's a relief to focus on ordinary town business again.$h
villager.Lewis.Cultists.01: Strangers in ceremonial clothing? That is not an official town activity.$u
villager.Lewis.Cultists.02: I'm aware of the reports. I simply don't see the benefit of causing a panic.$u
villager.Lewis.Severed.01: The valley has endured a great deal over the years. It always finds its footing.$h
villager.Lewis.Severed.02: I'd like our next town meeting to be about flowers. Just flowers.$h
villager.Lewis.Temple.01: I've contacted the appropriate people. That's all I can say for now.$u
villager.Lewis.Temple.02: We need to keep the town calm until we understand what we're dealing with.$u
villager.Lewis.Unease.01: The town hasn't had this many unusual reports in years. I'm looking into it.$u
villager.Lewis.Unease.02: I've asked people to stick to well-lit paths after dusk. Purely precautionary.
villager.Lewis.Whispers.01: We've had a few complaints about strange noises near the woods.$u
villager.Lewis.Whispers.02: I would appreciate it if everyone avoided spreading alarming rumors.
villager.Linus.Aftermath.01: The birds have returned to their old resting places. A good sign.$h
villager.Linus.Aftermath.02: The woods are patient. I think they've begun to forgive us.$h
villager.Linus.Cultists.01: Those cloaked wanderers do not move like people at home in the woods.$u
villager.Linus.Cultists.02: I have seen fires in places where no camp could stand.$u
villager.Linus.Severed.01: I slept well under the stars. They seem brighter now.$h
villager.Linus.Severed.02: The forest is quiet again. Not empty, just at peace.$h
villager.Linus.Temple.01: Something beneath the old ground is trying to remember how to breathe.$s
villager.Linus.Temple.02: Even the wild creatures know to stay away from the forgotten paths.$u
villager.Linus.Unease.01: The forest gives warnings, if you know how to hear them. Lately, it has been very clear.$u
villager.Linus.Unease.02: I found tracks in the leaves that ended without turning around.$u
villager.Linus.Whispers.01: The night sounds have changed. Something is listening where there was once only wind.$u
villager.Linus.Whispers.02: The animals have been sleeping closer to my tent lately.$u
villager.Marlon.Aftermath.01: The guild's patrols have been uneventful. I hope that's the new pattern.$h
villager.Marlon.Aftermath.02: There are battles you can't win with steel alone. Remember that.$h
villager.Marlon.Cultists.01: Those hooded figures are organized. That's what worries me more than their clothes.$u
villager.Marlon.Cultists.02: I've seen monsters run from the woods lately. Monsters, mind you.$u
villager.Marlon.Severed.01: The valley has had its share of darkness. This time, the dawn held.$h
villager.Marlon.Severed.02: I've closed the incident in my records. Not forgotten it, mind you.$h
villager.Marlon.Temple.01: The disturbance reaches farther than the temple's old stones.$u
villager.Marlon.Temple.02: Keep your blade sharp, farmer. Some doors shouldn't be opened without a way back.$u
villager.Marlon.Unease.01: The guild's received reports of unusual movement near the forest.$u
villager.Marlon.Unease.02: I've asked the younger adventurers not to take the western trail alone.$u
villager.Marlon.Whispers.01: My sword rattled in its sheath the other night. Hadn't touched it.$u
villager.Marlon.Whispers.02: There are old tracks on the mountain that don't belong to any monster I know.
villager.Marnie.Aftermath.01: The cows are finally calm. It does my heart good.$h
villager.Marnie.Aftermath.02: Everyone in the barn slept last night, including me.$h
villager.Marnie.Cultists.01: I saw people in dark clothes near the pasture fence. They walked away before I could call out.$u
villager.Marnie.Cultists.02: The chickens have been huddling together after sunset. Poor things.$u
villager.Marnie.Severed.01: The animals are happy again. That's all the reassurance I need.$h
villager.Marnie.Severed.02: The pasture feels like home again, doesn't it?$h
villager.Marnie.Temple.01: The animals were restless through the night. None of us got much sleep.$u
villager.Marnie.Temple.02: I've double-checked every latch on the barn. Something has them frightened.$u
villager.Marnie.Unease.01: The animals sense something I can't see. I've been bringing them inside early.$u
villager.Marnie.Unease.02: I don't like how quiet the woods get just before sundown.$u
villager.Marnie.Whispers.01: The cows kept turning toward the forest all evening.$u
villager.Marnie.Whispers.02: One of the goats refused to go into the barn. That's not like her.
villager.Maru.Aftermath.01: The readings settled overnight! Finally, something makes sense.$h
villager.Maru.Aftermath.02: I might actually finish my robot now that the equipment's behaving.$h
villager.Maru.Cultists.01: There were shapes in my telescope that didn't match the landscape.$u
villager.Maru.Cultists.02: I got a reading from the forest that shouldn't be physically possible.$u
villager.Maru.Severed.01: All the test runs passed. I think I can finally stop troubleshooting.$h
villager.Maru.Severed.02: Maybe the universe doesn't need an explanation for every little thing.$h
villager.Maru.Temple.01: Whatever's happening is affecting more than one kind of sensor.$u
villager.Maru.Temple.02: I wish I could help Dad explain the data. It seems to be getting worse.$u
villager.Maru.Unease.01: I've ruled out electrical interference. That leaves an answer I don't like.$u
villager.Maru.Unease.02: My machine recorded a tiny pulse every night at the same hour.$u
villager.Maru.Whispers.01: My prototype compass twitched toward the forest. It wasn't supposed to do that.$u
villager.Maru.Whispers.02: Dad's measurements have been unusual. He won't stop checking them.
villager.Pam.Aftermath.01: The bus started right up today. Beautiful sound.$h
villager.Pam.Aftermath.02: It's been a nice, ordinary day on the road. I'll take it.$h
villager.Pam.Cultists.01: A bunch of figures crossed the road and vanished into the trees. Not funny.$s
villager.Pam.Cultists.02: I don't like driving past the forest anymore. There. I said it.
villager.Pam.Severed.01: Nothing strange in the mirrors all week. Suits me fine.$h
villager.Pam.Severed.02: Road's clear, engine's running, sun's out. Can't complain.$h
villager.Pam.Temple.01: The bus stalled for a heartbeat near the old path. Never done that before.$u
villager.Pam.Temple.02: I wish whatever's making trouble would take it somewhere else.
villager.Pam.Unease.01: I keep seeing a light behind the bus in my mirror. Turns out there's nothing there.$u
villager.Pam.Unease.02: There've been more people asking for rides before sunset lately.$u
villager.Pam.Whispers.01: Saw something move by the bus stop after dark. Probably a deer. Probably.$u
villager.Pam.Whispers.02: The road felt longer than usual this morning. That's a strange thing to say.
villager.Penny.Aftermath.01: The children were laughing through lessons today. Such a relief.$h
villager.Penny.Aftermath.02: We took class outside again, and the whole morning felt lighter.$h
villager.Penny.Cultists.01: Jas says she saw people standing among the trees. I don't think she made it up.$u
villager.Penny.Cultists.02: I try to answer the children's questions without frightening them. It's getting harder.$u
villager.Penny.Severed.01: Jas drew a picture of the flowers by the river today. No shadows at all.$h
villager.Penny.Severed.02: It's lovely to see the children thinking about ordinary things again.$h
villager.Penny.Temple.01: The children keep asking whether something bad is coming. I wish I knew what to say.$u
villager.Penny.Temple.02: I read them a story about finding your way home. It helped us all.$h
villager.Penny.Unease.01: Some of the stories the children tell have been rather unsettling.$u
villager.Penny.Unease.02: I moved our lessons indoors today. It seemed kinder.$u
villager.Penny.Whispers.01: Vincent's been drawing the same strange symbol again and again. He says he saw it in a dream.$u
villager.Penny.Whispers.02: The children seem more distracted lately. I hope they're sleeping well.
villager.Pierre.Aftermath.01: The shop feels busy in a normal way again. I'm glad.$h
villager.Pierre.Aftermath.02: Everyone's buying seeds instead of candles. That's more like it.$h
villager.Pierre.Cultists.01: Customers are talking about strangers at the edge of town. Not great for business.$u
villager.Pierre.Cultists.02: If there really are cloaked people around, I hope they shop somewhere else.$u
villager.Pierre.Severed.01: I think a little routine is good for everyone. Especially shopping locally.$h
villager.Pierre.Severed.02: The valley's back to its usual self. And so are sales.$h
villager.Pierre.Temple.01: I sold out of lantern oil again. People don't usually buy this much in summer.$u
villager.Pierre.Temple.02: Even I have to admit something strange has been happening lately.$u
villager.Pierre.Unease.01: People are stocking up on supplies. I wish they'd say what they're worried about.$u
villager.Pierre.Unease.02: I've heard a dozen versions of the same rumor. None of them make any sense.
villager.Pierre.Whispers.01: Business has been odd lately. Customers keep glancing at the windows.$u
villager.Pierre.Whispers.02: Someone bought every candle I had. Said it was for 'peace of mind.'
villager.Robin.Aftermath.01: The house has been quiet again. No unexplained creaking.$h
villager.Robin.Aftermath.02: I've finally been able to get through a whole day of carpentry without distractions.$h
villager.Robin.Cultists.01: I saw three people standing near the trail. They didn't answer when I called.$u
villager.Robin.Cultists.02: I'm telling everyone to finish their outdoor work before dark.$u
villager.Robin.Severed.01: Good solid wood, steady ground, a roof overhead. That's enough for me.$h
villager.Robin.Severed.02: I don't know what changed, but my workshop feels normal again.$h
villager.Robin.Temple.01: The ground shifted under the workshop, but none of the supports moved.$u
villager.Robin.Temple.02: I've worked with old stone before. Something about the hills worries me.$u
villager.Robin.Unease.01: The wood's been splitting along patterns I haven't seen before.$u
villager.Robin.Unease.02: I keep hearing knocking when no one's working. It's driving me up the wall.
villager.Robin.Whispers.01: A beam in the workshop gave a strange little shudder last night.$u
villager.Robin.Whispers.02: I was out cutting timber and found a perfectly round patch where nothing had grown.
villager.Sam.Aftermath.01: Played a full set with no weird noise from the amp. Finally!$h
villager.Sam.Aftermath.02: The new song I wrote is actually upbeat. That's progress.$h
villager.Sam.Cultists.01: Saw people between the trees when I was out skating. I came straight home.$u
villager.Sam.Cultists.02: Dude, the woods are giving me the creeps lately. And that's saying something.
villager.Sam.Severed.01: We've been practicing more. It's nice to think about music instead of shadows.$h
villager.Sam.Severed.02: I think our next song should just be about having a good day.$h
villager.Sam.Temple.01: I tried writing a song about what's happening. It just came out really dark.$u
villager.Sam.Temple.02: Whatever's going on, can it please stop messing with the sound around here?
villager.Sam.Unease.01: Seb and I heard something from the forest. Neither of us wanted to check it out.$u
villager.Sam.Unease.02: My music's been sounding off lately. Like someone's playing a note beneath mine.$u
villager.Sam.Whispers.01: There was this weird noise behind the house. Almost like a guitar string being pulled really slowly.$u
villager.Sam.Whispers.02: My amp picked up a sound when it wasn't plugged in. That's... not good.
villager.Sandy.Aftermath.01: The air feels clear again, even all the way out here.$h
villager.Sandy.Aftermath.02: I've been sleeping much better lately. Whatever it was must have passed.$h
villager.Sandy.Cultists.01: The merchants have been telling stories about cloaked travelers on the valley roads.$u
villager.Sandy.Cultists.02: I saw a star flicker over the western hills. It wasn't a cloud.$u
villager.Sandy.Severed.01: The desert stars have been beautiful lately. Nothing unusual among them.$h
villager.Sandy.Severed.02: I hope your valley is peaceful. Mine feels that way again.$h
villager.Sandy.Temple.01: I felt the ground tremble out here yesterday. I wonder what happened back in the valley.$u
villager.Sandy.Temple.02: There's a strange heaviness on the breeze from the mountains.$u
villager.Sandy.Unease.01: A customer said the mountains near Pelican Town looked darker than usual.$u
villager.Sandy.Unease.02: I've been having dreams about a road that leads nowhere. Very odd.$u
villager.Sandy.Whispers.01: The desert wind carried a strange echo last night. It came from the direction of the valley.$u
villager.Sandy.Whispers.02: Sometimes even out here, you can feel when something far away has changed.
villager.Sebastian.Aftermath.01: Rode my bike after dark for the first time in a while. Felt good.$h
villager.Sebastian.Aftermath.02: My dreams have been normal again. Well, normal for me.$h
villager.Sebastian.Cultists.01: I saw a group in black robes on the trail. I didn't stick around to ask questions.$u
villager.Sebastian.Cultists.02: There were shapes under the trees that stayed still when everything else moved.$u
villager.Sebastian.Severed.01: The forest's quiet again. I missed being able to disappear into it for a while.$h
villager.Sebastian.Severed.02: I sat by the lake last night. No strange sounds. Just frogs.$h
villager.Sebastian.Temple.01: I went out at midnight and the whole road felt... stretched. Hard to explain.$u
villager.Sebastian.Temple.02: I've stopped taking the mountain shortcut. Something about it is wrong.$u
villager.Sebastian.Unease.01: The woods are the one place I go to clear my head. They're not helping lately.$u
villager.Sebastian.Unease.02: I keep waking up right before the same dream ends. It's getting old.
villager.Sebastian.Whispers.01: My monitor flickered at three in the morning. There wasn't a power outage.$u
villager.Sebastian.Whispers.02: Took my bike out late and heard footsteps where there wasn't a road.
villager.Shane.Aftermath.01: Charlie came running for breakfast today. Back to normal.$h
villager.Shane.Aftermath.02: Finally had a decent night's sleep. Don't jinx it.
villager.Shane.Cultists.01: I saw people standing along the treeline. Not customers from Joja, that's for sure.$u
villager.Shane.Cultists.02: I've been staying close to the ranch after dark. Don't make a thing of it.
villager.Shane.Severed.01: Been looking after the chickens. They've got a good life, you know?$h
villager.Shane.Severed.02: It's easier to get through the day when nothing weird's happening outside.
villager.Shane.Temple.01: The chickens haven't slept right in days. Neither have I.$u
villager.Shane.Temple.02: I don't know what's happening out there, but I wish it'd knock it off.
villager.Shane.Unease.01: Charlie won't go near the fence at night. That bird knows something.$u
villager.Shane.Unease.02: Even the saloon feels tense lately. Kinda defeats the point.
villager.Shane.Whispers.01: The chickens were acting strange this morning. Not a fan.$u
villager.Shane.Whispers.02: Heard something near the coop after closing. Didn't see anything.
villager.Vincent.Aftermath.01: I played outside all day! Mom wasn't worried this time.$h
villager.Vincent.Aftermath.02: The trees look like regular trees again.$h
villager.Vincent.Cultists.01: There were some people way out in the woods. I didn't like them.$u
villager.Vincent.Cultists.02: Mom says I have to stay inside when the sun goes down.$u
villager.Vincent.Severed.01: Jas and me made a really good fort!$h
villager.Vincent.Severed.02: I haven't had a scary dream all week.$h
villager.Vincent.Temple.01: I don't want to hear any more spooky stories today.$u
villager.Vincent.Temple.02: I had a bad dream. Penny let me draw something nice instead.$u
villager.Vincent.Unease.01: Jas says the trees look different at night. I don't want to check.$u
villager.Vincent.Unease.02: I saw a shadow on the wall and it didn't match anything in my room.
villager.Vincent.Whispers.01: I heard a funny song from the trees! Mom said I imagined it.$u
villager.Vincent.Whispers.02: I dreamed there was a door at the end of our street.
villager.Willy.Aftermath.01: The fish are biting again. Good to see the sea acting like itself.$h
villager.Willy.Aftermath.02: Slept on the boat last night. First peaceful sleep I've had in weeks.$h
villager.Willy.Cultists.01: Saw lanterns moving along the shore where no path runs.$u
villager.Willy.Cultists.02: Even the crabs have been heading away from the deeper water.$u
villager.Willy.Severed.01: The water's calm, the gulls are noisy, and all's right with the world.$h
villager.Willy.Severed.02: Some storms leave you appreciating a good quiet morning.$h
villager.Willy.Temple.01: A strange tide came through, though the moon was in the wrong place for it.$u
villager.Willy.Temple.02: There's an old feeling in the water. Can't say I care for it.$u
villager.Willy.Unease.01: The sea's been holding its breath at night, if you know what I mean.$u
villager.Willy.Unease.02: Heard a sound over the water that no bird ever made.$u
villager.Willy.Whispers.01: Something's been stirring the water without making a ripple.$u
villager.Willy.Whispers.02: The fish bit right up until sunrise. Then everything went still.
villager.Wizard.Aftermath.01: The presence beyond the veil has been driven back. Take no comfort in its apparent silence alone.$u
villager.Wizard.Aftermath.02: The worst has passed, but severing the final bond requires a choice only you can make.$u
villager.Wizard.Cultists.01: The figures in the woods are not the cause. They are drawn toward it.$u
villager.Wizard.Cultists.02: The boundary has grown restless. Your choices now have consequences beyond your land.$u
villager.Wizard.Severed.01: The bond has been severed. Your art is yours now, and its cost need not feed that darkness.$h
villager.Wizard.Severed.02: There is an uncommon stillness in the arcane currents. You have earned it.$h
villager.Wizard.Temple.01: You have stepped close to an ancient threshold. Do not linger there unprepared.$u
villager.Wizard.Temple.02: The temple's stones were made to keep something contained, not to be worshipped.$u
villager.Wizard.Unease.01: Do not mistake the absence of a visible threat for safety.$u
villager.Wizard.Unease.02: There are seals older than this valley. Some have begun to thin.$u
villager.Wizard.Whispers.01: The currents around your farm have shifted. Be judicious in what you awaken.$u
villager.Wizard.Whispers.02: You have touched a power that notices when it is touched in return.$u
